v.moneyOpt: Leave empty for no limit, or enter an amount above 0 with up to 2 places.
v.reason10: Give a reason of 10 to 500 letters.

settings.title: Accounting settings
settings.intro: Leave an amount empty for no limit.
settings.journal: Voucher amount that needs a second person to approve
settings.cash: Warn when a cash payment is above
settings.attachment: Bill or slip reference required above
settings.expenseApproval: Expense amount that needs a second person to approve
settings.costCentre: Branch or cost centre needed on income and expense lines
settings.costCentreLabel: Income and expense lines need a branch or cost centre

opening.title: Opening balances
opening.intro: Cash, bank, fixed assets, loans and capital at go-live. Customer dues, supplier dues and stock open from their own screens. Any difference goes to Opening balance equity.
opening.asOn: As on (the day before you start billing, YYYY-MM-DD)
opening.totals: Debit {{debit}} | Credit {{credit}} | Opening balance equity takes {{plug}} {{side}}
opening.locked: A period has been closed, so they are locked.
opening.canReverse: They can be reversed and entered again until a period is closed.
opening.none: Opening balances have not been entered.

v.date: Enter a real date up to today as YYYY-MM-DD.

year.title: Year-end closing
year.intro: Closing moves the profit or loss of the year into retained earnings with one journal on the last day, locks the year and its months, and prepares the next year.
year.profit: Net profit moved to retained earnings: {{amount}}
year.warnLock: This locks the year. It cannot be undone here.

export.title: Export for the accountant
export.intro: The journals of a period as one file. The same period with the same content is exported once; every export is recorded.
export.replay: Same as an earlier export: nothing new.

v.to: End date must be a real date and not before the start.
v.name: Ledger name can be 100 letters at most.

inter.title: Cash between branches
inter.intro: One journal with both sides: the sending branch is owed, the receiving branch owes. The consolidated books show neither.

v.same: The two branches must be different.
v.cash: Choose the cash or bank ledger.
v.what: Write what it is for, 3 to 300 letters.

tpl.title: Recurring expenses
tpl.intro: A template makes one draft expense each month on its day. Running it twice never makes a second draft for the same month.
tpl.generate: Make the drafts that are due
tpl.name: Name
tpl.noReport: Nothing reached the books in this period.

v.name: Name must be 2 to 80 letters.
v.day: Day must be a whole number from 1 to 28.

ai.intro: Ask a question or tell me what to do. I read the same data your role can see.
ai.tooLong: That took too many steps. Please ask in a narrower way.
ai.offline: No connection. Check the network and try again. Pull down on a list to refresh.
ai.note: The assistant can be wrong. Money and customers are shown to you to confirm before anything is saved. Voice input and streaming of words are not in the app yet.
ai.denied: You do not have permission for this screen.
ai.notScanned: Not checked: {{parts}}. A short list is not a clean bill of health.
ai.advice: These are suggestions from rules over your data, not facts.
ai.snoozeReason: Hidden for a week from the phone

fc.title: Demand forecast
fc.fellBack: A newer method was tried but the basic method is shown.
fc.few: {{n}} could not be planned (not enough data).

ro.title: Reorder suggestions
ro.shortAll: Left out for want of budget: {{value}}
ro.noOrder: Nothing is ordered from here. Saving suggestions only lists them for a person to approve.
ro.proposed: Saved. A person must approve each one.

rec.title: AI suggestions
rec.intro: Nothing here has happened yet. A person approves a suggestion, and then only a draft is made.
rec.twoPeople: This needs two different people to approve.
rec.reasonBad: Write a reason of 3 to 500 letters.
rec.note: Approving shows you the same details the server checks. If the suggestion changed meanwhile, it will not be approved.

ex.title: Expiry advice
ex.none: No stock is at risk in this period.
ex.noCost: You cannot see stock cost, so discounts cannot be checked against it.
ex.transfer: Another branch can sell it: {{to}}, {{n}} units
ex.proposed: Saved as a suggestion for approval.

sp.title: Supplier rate check
sp.intro: Suppliers whose rates were above their own usual rates in posted bills.

sc.title: Budget what-if
sc.intro: See which open reorder suggestions a budget can pay for. Nothing is ordered or saved.
sc.budget: Budget in rupees (leave blank to use cash only)
sc.budgetBad: Enter an amount above 0 with up to 2 decimals.
sc.change: Purchase price change in percent (-50 to 200)
sc.cash: Also limit by the cash the books can spare?
sc.needLimit: Give a budget, or choose to limit by cash.
sc.nothing: This is a trial only. Nothing was ordered.
sc.billIntro: Choose a PDF, PNG or JPEG up to 4 MB. The fields are read for you to check. No bill is made.
sc.labelIntro: Choose a photo or PDF of the label. The fields are read for you to check. No product is created.
sc.tooBig: The file is larger than 4 MB.
sc.notAllowed: Choose a PDF, PNG or JPEG file.
sc.duplicate: This file was read before. Showing the earlier result.
sc.noIssues: No problems found by the checks.
sc.notCreated: No product was created. Open the product form to add it.
sc.billNote: This only reads the bill. Making a draft purchase bill from it is done on the purchase screens.

ac.title: Forecast accuracy
ac.beats: Forecast beat 'same as last week' on {{n}}% of products
ac.how: Checked by pretending to forecast past weeks and comparing with what sold.
ac.noDrift: No product is getting clearly worse.
ac.scanned: Done. Worsening products are flagged for a person to review.
ac.noSwitch: Nothing is switched by itself. A person decides.

pc.title: Check one product
pc.beatsNo: Not better than 'same as last week'
pc.above: Selling much more than the same weeks last year
pc.below: Selling much less than the same weeks last year
pc.vsLastYear: Last 4 weeks {{now}}, same weeks last year {{then}}
pc.review: A person may review adopting the challenger.

cu.title: Customer insights
cu.note: Scores explain themselves and only help a person decide. Nothing is blocked, changed or sent.
cu.noneChurn: No customer looks inactive or at risk.
cu.noPattern: Not enough payments to see a pattern.
cu.spend: Spend change vs the 90 days before: {{n}}%

cf.title: Cash outlook
cf.problem: Cash may run short within {{n}} days.
cf.notMoney: A projection to help you plan. It does not move any money.

pa.title: Price advice
pa.intro: Rules only: your cost, floor margin, MRP, and how sales are moving. Nothing is changed.
pa.mustFix: The current price breaks a rule (above MRP or below the floor margin).
pa.proposed: Saved as a suggestion for approval.

mk.title: Message drafts
mk.intro: Choose a reviewed template, language and channel. The text is made from facts; nothing is sent from here.
mk.problems: {{n}} rule problem(s) in the text. Do not use it.

cd.title: Crop doctor
cd.intro: Matches only against approved knowledge. Always check the field before acting.
cd.needOne: Add a photo or describe the symptoms.
cd.noPhotoService: Photo identification is not set up on the server. Describe the symptoms instead.
cd.tooBig: The photo is larger than 3 MB.
cd.notImage: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.

av.title: Crop advisory
av.none: No approved advice for this crop yet.

wx.title: Weather alerts
wx.noProvider: No weather service is set up on the server.
wx.summary: Next 24 hours: rain {{rain}} mm, {{min}} to {{max}} C, wind up to {{wind}} km/h
wx.note: Alerts come from fixed rules on the stored forecast. Nothing is sent.

sr.title: Smart search
sr.intro: Finds products by name, local name, brand, category or crop, including shop nicknames.

vo.title: Spoken order draft
vo.intro: Type or dictate with your phone keyboard. This app has no built-in microphone reading. The result is a draft only; nothing is billed.

cl.title: File a document
cl.intro: The suggestion is only a suggestion. You choose the category and the file is stored only after you confirm.
cl.tooBig: The file is larger than 4 MB.
cl.notRead: The file could not be read. Choose a PDF, PNG or JPEG.

tr.title: Staff training
tr.question: Your question
tr.noMine: You have not taken a quiz yet.

rp.title: Ask a report
rp.intro: Ask in your own words, for example: sales last month by village. The report is run with your own access.
rp.question: Your question
rp.truncated: Only the first rows are shown.
rp.note: The text is made from the figures above. Check them before you share.

rd.title: Saved report drafts
rd.note: Editing a draft is not available in the app yet.

st.title: Strategy and health
st.intro: A draft made by fixed rules from the last two months or quarters. Nothing is set until the owner approves it.
st.noScore: Shop health cannot be scored yet
st.partial: Some parts could not be measured and are left out of the score.

bc.title: Compare branches
bc.intro: Pick a product to see which branch is short, which has extra, and suggested moves.
bc.noCost: Cost not set (the owner sets a cost per unit).

ex2.title: Expansion what-if
ex2.intro: Your own assumptions, 24 months. Not a forecast.
ex2.margin: Gross margin % (empty = your own last 12 months)
ex2.name: Name to save

sh.title: Shelf photo check
sh.intro: Photograph one shelf or rack. The photo is read for an estimate and compared with system stock. Stock is not changed.
sh.estimate: An estimate from a photo, not a count.
sh.openCount: Open a stock count for the differences

vl.title: Village trends
vl.hidden: {{n}} village(s) with too few customers are not shown.

cm.title: Crop map and shortage
cm.noFactors: No crop requirement factors are entered yet, so no shortage can be predicted.
cm.unassigned: {{n}} crop plan(s) could not be assigned to a product.

rk.title: Risk register
rk.reasonBad: Give a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
rk.reopenNote: A closed case can be reopened by a different person than the one who closed it.

gv.title: AI usage and evaluation
gv.used: Used {{used}} of {{quota}} AI calls this month
gv.counts: {{comparisons}} method comparisons, {{promotions}} promotions, {{drift}} drift cases, {{methods}} methods in force
gv.csvNote: The CSV download is not in the app yet.

po.title: Approval policy
po.intro: Approval cannot be switched off. These rules make it stricter.
po.distinct: The approver must be a different person than the one who asked
po.second: A second person must also approve
po.ownerAbove: Owner must approve above (blank = no limit)
po.limitBad: Leave blank or enter a number above 0.
po.transfer: Transfer cost per unit (blank = not set)

fu.title: Feedback and outcome
fu.outcomeNote: Reads goods received and stock-outs since the suggestion. You may enter a quantity received outside the system.

au.title: AI decision log
au.note: Every AI call is recorded. Inputs and outputs are kept as hashes, not text.
